Our office was hosted by the Town of Port Royal, along with Rebecca Cavalier, a marine biologist with the South Carolina Department of Natural Resources, to talk about the best ways to responsibly interact with wildlife in our area.

The local community joined to learn about alligators and the best practices to use when you encounter one. We gained valuable insight into safety practices, habitat conservation, and what we can do to preserve the wildlife of the Lowcountry.

South Carolina STRONG.

We will always support the shrimpers and fishermen who make the Lowcountry what it is. They are the farmers of the sea and they deserve the same respect and recognition.

South Carolina STRONG.

Our office had the opportunity to speak at the most recent Beaufort County Veterans Council event.

The council meets to discuss resources available to veterans, nonprofit and for-profit veterans groups, and brings in government entities to provide support in these areas.

The work they do to support veterans in the Lowcountry is unmatched.

South Carolina is safer when its officers are respected, resourced, and backed by the people they serve. While Washington plays politics with public safety, we will keep standing with the men and women wearing the badge.
